title: About
description: Senior Game Designer based in Brazil, open to remote roles in Europe or North America.

blocks.html: Six years in, I've worn multiple hats: from balancing individual combat frames to aligning cross-discipline teams. My focus is owning complex features end-to-end and building scalable design frameworks that empower production. As a Senior Game Designer, I thrive where systems architecture meets team collaboration.
